versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Major update: agent-logger v2 adds structured JSON logging, advanced features, and enhanced CI integration.

- Structured JSON logs with log rotation, query/filter, session replay, tail mode, and audit trail.
- Major CLI redesign: new commands for logging, querying, replaying, tailing, and self-test.
- New README and updated documentation; legacy docs and test suite removed.
- Zero dependencies; ensures compatibility across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
